PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 - <<'PY'
import ast
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

before_path = Path('docs/evidence/snapshots/v1-05c2e1-before-managed-run-results-fixture.py')
after_path = Path('tests/test_managed_run.py')
before_raw, after_raw = before_path.read_bytes(), after_path.read_bytes()
before, after = ast.parse(before_raw), ast.parse(after_raw)
targets = {
    'test_disabled_orchestrator_exits_before_gpu_lease_or_startup',
    'test_orchestrator_rejects_external_gpu_compute_before_startup',
}
expected = ast.dump(ast.parse('runner.results_dir = tmp_path').body[0], include_attributes=False)
removed = []
for node in after.body:
    if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name in targets:
        matches = [i for i, statement in enumerate(node.body)
                   if ast.dump(statement, include_attributes=False) == expected]
        assert len(matches) == 1, (node.name, matches)
        index = matches[0]
        assert isinstance(node.body[index - 1], ast.Assign)
        assert ast.unparse(node.body[index - 1]) == 'runner = Orze.__new__(Orze)'
        removed.append(node.name)
        del node.body[index]
assert set(removed) == targets
normalized_before = ast.dump(before, include_attributes=False)
normalized_after = ast.dump(after, include_attributes=False)
assert normalized_before == normalized_after
original_assertions = [ast.dump(node, include_attributes=False)
                       for node in ast.walk(before) if isinstance(node, ast.Assert)]
new_assertions = [ast.dump(node, include_attributes=False)
                  for node in ast.walk(ast.parse(after_raw)) if isinstance(node, ast.Assert)]
assert original_assertions == new_assertions
print(json.dumps({
    'before_sha256': hashlib.sha256(before_raw).hexdigest(),
    'after_sha256': hashlib.sha256(after_raw).hexdigest(),
    'added_assignment_count': len(removed),
    'functions': sorted(removed),
    'all_other_ast_equal': True,
    'assert_count_before': len(original_assertions),
    'assert_count_after': len(new_assertions),
    'assert_asts_in_order_equal': True,
    'normalized_complete_ast_sha256': hashlib.sha256(normalized_before.encode()).hexdigest(),
}, sort_keys=True, indent=2))
PY

after = Path('tests/test_managed_run.py').read_bytes()

    if isinstance(function, ast.FunctionDef) and function.name in names:
        added = [node for node in function.body if ast.unparse(node) == 'runner.results_dir = tmp_path']

lines = after.splitlines(keepends=True)
